title: NV Magnetometry locale bundle
description: Shape of a locale bundle contributed via PR (locales/<code>.json). A bundle may translate any subset of the keys under 'strings' — missing keys fall back to English at runtime, so a bundle never needs to be complete to be valid or useful.

endonym.description: The language's own name for itself, e.g. "العربية" — shown in the language picker.

englishName.description: English name of the language, for contributors and as a fallback label.

direction.description: Self-declared text direction. Not inferred from the runtime's Intl support, so any script works without platform assumptions.

targetsVersion.description: Which locales/en.js STRINGS_VERSION this bundle was written against. Informational — used to flag a bundle as possibly stale, never to reject it.

translationStatus.description: Optional provenance marker set by scripts/translate-locale.mjs: "machine" means some or all of this bundle's strings were machine-translated and not yet reviewed by a fluent speaker (see issue #4's verification step). Absent means human-quality by convention, the status quo for every hand-contributed bundle before this field existed — a verifier should remove this field (or set it to "human") once they've checked the content.

strings.description: Dot-path-addressed nested string tree. Any key may be omitted; omitted keys fall back to English per-key at runtime (src/i18n.js translate()).

catalog.description: One entry per src/catalog.js visualizer, keyed by that entry's id (e.g. "rabi"). patternProperties instead of an enumerated list per id, so a new visualizer never needs a schema edit here -- see src/catalog.js and CLAUDE.md's Visualizer catalog section.
